messages:
Alex R.: Postmortem follow-up: list of GPU/autoscale action items from yesterday's outage. I pulled recurring patterns — spikes coincided with batch reruns + canary traffic. Need owners and timelines.
Maya S.: +1. I can take scheduler tuning. First pass: lower preemption aggressiveness and add a soft headroom floor per pool.
Chris L.: I'll own quota/backstop policy. Proposal: auto-enforce a soft quota that kicks in at 85% cluster GPU util and a hard backstop at 95%.
Priya K.: I'll write the runbook for surge mitigation (who to page, quick rollbacks, priority routing). ETA 3 business days.
Alex R.: Concrete deliverables: (1) scheduler tweaks (Maya) — config and canary by EOD next Friday. (2) quota policy (Chris) — RFC + deploy plan in 1 week. (3) headroom runbook (Priya) — initial draft in 3 days.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2023-4321 archived. Followups: see GH issues and the postmortem doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2023-4321
Maya S.: notes on scheduler tuning: we should change preemption_threshold from 0.9 -> 0.97 and increase min_reserved_gpus to 12% per pool. Test plan: traffic replay in staging for peak patterns + disabled autoscale for deterministic results.
Chris L.: Quota policy details: add a cluster-wide soft quota metric, alert channel #incidents when soft quota breaches, and circuit-breaker to route low-priority requests to a cheaper model variant. I'll open GH PR linking to infra repo: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/742
Priya K.: Runbook outline: 1) Detect surge (dashboard queries), 2) Engage Maya/Chris, 3) Apply backstop (chris), 4) Re-route queries (api config), 5) Postmortem triggers. I'll include playbook snippets and kubectl/orchctl commands.
Alex R.: Quick commands we can use in playbook:
```
# headroom check
orchctl capacity report --cluster prod --format json | jq '.pools[] | {name, utilization, headroom_percent}'
# show preemption config
kubectl get configmap scheduler-config -n infra -o yaml | sed -n '/preemption/q'
```
Chris L.: I'll prototype the quota enforcement as a preview feature in staging today. If anyone wants to pair on the circuit-breaker routing rules, ping me.
Maya S.: Recommend adding a rolling safety test: every night run a 10m traffic spike against staging to validate autoscale headroom. I'll add to ci/ops.
Alex R.: Ownership recap in case-thread: Maya = scheduler tuning + nightly safety test; Chris = quota/backstop + circuit-breaker; Priya = runbook + pager duties doc. Due dates: Maya Fri (next), Chris Mon (next week), Priya Wed (3 days).
Alex R.: Also: weave in capacity forecasting (infra-bot has a headroom weekly report). infra-bot, can you attach last 8 weeks of GPU headroom by pool?
infra-bot: Uploaded report: https://reports.redwood.ai/headroom/last_8_weeks.csv (pools: gpu-large,gpu-small,gpu-burst).
Chris L.: Noted recurring pattern: gpu-burst pool exhausted during customer batch windows, we should consider reservation or temp borrowing from gpu-large. Adding item to RFC.
Priya K.: I'll schedule a 30min sync next Tue to review PRs + runbook draft. Adding calendar invite.
Alex R.: Thanks everyone. We'll track items in the remediation tracker: REM-7894 and link to postmortem doc. Please update your subtask when started. :thumbsup:
